t0343-01.gloss: Field residue and response material meet in one ambiguous personal bundle.
t0343-01.rival_reading: Field workers or an emergency crew could have assembled this bundle; the mixed residue and road tape do not show which came first.

t0343-02.gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
t0343-02.rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
